hypothesis: Iter 88 = remediate the two gate failures the iter-87 meal-timing fix EXPOSED (glucose_mape=0.2733>0.2, hr_mape=0.1858>0.15) — NOT a regression to revert. Background: iter-87 (459c9b9) correctly put meal absorption on the window-offset clock; run trainer-lm886 then failed the gate on glucose_mape/hr_mape while SOLVING the meal target (verifier.overall 0.8675, meal no longer failing; textbook 0.8389). Root-cause analysis: iter-86's passing glucose_mape<=0.20/hr<0.15 were PARTLY ARTIFACTS of the bug — the meal-timing offset pushed all 3 meals' absorption OUT of the scored eval window (t=510-690), so the model coasted near-flat and trivially matched the near-baseline teacher. With meals on the correct clock the eval now contains real postprandial signal, exposing a structural weakness: in dG=-(Sg+X)(G-Gb_emb)+Ra*appearance (metabolic.py), Gb_emb is the ONLY per-patient glucose lever while Ra/Si/Sg are GLOBAL scalars, so each patient's meal-amplitude mismatch was absorbed into Gb, biasing the fasting setpoint (glucose_mape up) and spilling through the cardiovascular coupling to HR (hr_mape up). FIXES (A+B+C+D): (A) metabolic.py — Ra gets a per-patient head ra_baseline_net mirroring glucose_baseline_net (zero-init, byte-identical cold start), so calibration fits excursion amplitude and baseline INDEPENDENTLY; (B) trainArgs default-baseline-weight 0.30->0.15 — the anchor pins zero-embedding HR to NORM_CENTER=70 but eval athletes rest ~52-63, and at 0.30 it overrode per-patient calibration -> hr_mape; halving it keeps the anti-drift guard while letting HR reach low baselines; (C) trainArgs trajectory-band 0.2->0.08 — at 0.2 the per-step zero-loss dead-zone (6 mg/dL glucose, 0.06C temp) exceeded the real window movement, so a flat line satisfied the trajectory loss (default-patient episodes already use 0.05 safely); (D) bergman_glucose_insulin.py — port the 5 stale iter-21 constants (gamma 0.015->0.07, h 80->95, Si 0.0002->0.0004, IC50_keto 10->15, k_bhb 0.03->0.005) so the ~22%-weight Bergman teacher stops contradicting full_body (averaging disagreeing teachers damps trajectories). Keeps ALL iter-86/87 structure (minimal-model setpoint, Gb_emb, Sg band, Si, meal-timing fix). ONE structural change (ra head); no phase/architecture change; trainArgs otherwise identical to iter-87.
expectedEffect: PRIMARY: glucose_mape returns <=0.20 (Ra head lets Gb stop absorbing amplitude error) and hr_mape returns <0.15 (looser HR anchor + Bergman consistency). SECONDARY: overall_weighted_mape improves from 0.1289; verifier_cat[meal] HOLDS >=0.65 (Ra head keeps its dose-response supervision, and the sharpened Bergman OGTT peak pushes meal amplitude UP not down) and verifier.overall holds ~0.87; textbook holds ~0.84. WATCH: (R1) verifier_cat[meal] must not fall below 0.65 — the Ra head could under-fit amplitude if calibration prefers baseline; check the meal category first. (R2) hr default-baseline must not re-inflate toward the historical +15 bpm/88 bpm drift at 0.15 weight (down from 0.30) — check hr baseline. (R3) glucose skill_vs_persistence stays deeply negative BY CONSTRUCTION (ratio vs a ~1% persistence floor on near-flat windows, documented since iter-77) — it is NOT a gate metric and must not be chased; judge on glucose_mape/hr_mape only. (R4) Ra head cold start is byte-identical (zero-init), so any change is learned, not an init shift.
